top_signals.title: Freightos founder takes board fight to shareholder vote
top_signals.summary:
Freightos’ board has agreed to put founder Zvi Schreiber’s proposals to a vote at its December annual meeting, escalating a dispute over the company’s focus on software over its booking platform. Schreiber, who resigned from the board in February, says the strategy is failing as AI threatens software products.

The post Freightos founder takes board fight to shareholder vote appeared first on FreightWaves.
